reviews_captured_by_me.text: Jeff and the team at Oak Ridge did an outstanding job on my kitchen cabinets. Everyone was very helpful and great to work with. If I had to.do it all over again, Oak Ridge would be my choice.

We worked with Jeff on new kitchen cabinets for a 39 year old home. Strongly recommend working with Oak Ridge. The quality of work is outstanding. Jeff provided suggestions to improve our original requests. Adam the installer also did an outstanding job. We are very happy we went with Oak Ridge. Strongly encourage going with Oak Ridge Custom Cabinetry. You won't regret it.

Just give them a call for a quote... Check them out... For me... Quality work.. fair prices.. no problems... No screwups... Used them instead of builders cabinet guys.  Just felt more comfortable with Oak Ridge... fyi.. if you see a bad review but almost all other reviews are good.. consider that the bad review is probably a competitor or knows Oak ridge competitor.. Oak Ridge is very conscientious on customer service.  Makes sense right..
